name: Drift
label: Drift REST (Salesloft) — contacts and conversations
description: Official Drift backend at https://driftapi.com (live 2026-08-20). Contacts are visitors, not seats. Configure the app Events URL for inbound webhooks. Sunset announced Mar 2026 — existing accounts still work. Customer owns the Drift/Salesloft account. Chat PII; minimize. OfficialApiNode. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email (PII); required by contact.create. Sent as attributes.email on contact.create / contact.update. Example: jane@example.com.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Chat message text for message.send. Official Drift `body` (the message, not a generic blob). Example: Thanks for writing in.

schema.label: externalId
schema.description: Your system's id for the contact on contact.create, sent as attributes.externalId. Example: crm-10042.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Contact display name on contact.create / contact.update, sent as attributes.name. Example: Jane Doe.

schema.label: attributes
schema.description: Drift contact attributes object for contact.create / contact.update (Drift nests every contact field under attributes); email, name and externalId inputs are merged into it. Custom attribute keys come from contact.customAttributes. Example: {"phone":"+14155550100","company":"Acme"}.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Message type for message.send (required by Drift). EXACT: chat | private_note; blank falls back to chat. Example: private_note.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Never includes accessToken. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Drift Bearer token (OAuth or PAT). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
